summary: Frontend testing for Network Dashboard 2FA Security feature. All requested features are working correctly - Security dialog opens from both header button and warning banner, TwoFactorSetup component renders properly with QR code setup flow, API Explorer navigation works, User Access Debug panel opens correctly.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - This is a minor accessibility warning that should be addressed by adding DialogDescription to the dialog component.

login_flow.details: Network admin (admkoodh@koodh.com) successfully logs in and redirects to Network Dashboard at /

2fa_warning_banner.details: Warning banner 'Beveilig je account met 2FA' is displayed when user doesn't have 2FA enabled, with '2FA Instellen' button

beveiliging_button.details: Header button 'Beveiliging' is visible and clickable, opens 'Account Beveiliging' dialog

security_dialog_from_banner.details: Clicking '2FA Instellen' in warning banner opens the security dialog with TwoFactorSetup component

security_dialog_from_header.details: Clicking 'Beveiliging' button in header opens the security dialog with TwoFactorSetup component

2fa_setup_flow.details: Clicking '2FA instellen' inside dialog starts the 2FA setup flow - QR code dialog appears with QR image, manual code entry option, instructions, and 'Volgende' button

api_explorer_button.details: API Explorer button navigates to /explorer page successfully (291 endpoints displayed)

user_access_debug_button.details: User Access Debug button opens debug panel showing user access information (10 users, 4 main sites, 9 access records)

features_verified: Login as network admin redirects to Network Dashboard
2FA warning banner displayed when totp_enabled is false
'2FA Instellen' button in banner opens security dialog
'Beveiliging' button in header opens security dialog
'2FA instellen' button in dialog starts 2FA setup flow
QR code dialog appears with QR image and manual code option
User Access Debug button opens debug panel
action_items: Consider adding DialogDescription to Security dialog to fix accessibility warning
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 2FA security features on Network Dashboard are working correctly. The Security dialog (Account Beveiliging) correctly wraps the TwoFactorSetup component and allows network admins to manage their 2FA settings directly from the Clara Global dashboard. Note: The button inside the dialog may require mouse coordinate click due to modal overlay issues with standard click methods.
